title: Typhoon Jangmi heading to Okinawa — 400+ flights cancelled, gusts 162km/h, JMA urgent warnings
snippet: Typhoon Jangmi projected to approach Okinawa/Amami June 1-2 before shifting northeast toward western Japan by June 3. JMA issued urgent warnings: extreme rainfall, violent winds, storm surges, landslides. 400+ ANA flights cancelled. Gusts up to 162km/h. Rainfall reaching 300mm by noon June 2. Evacuations urged for elderly.
tag_reason: 기존 temp-evt-2001(태풍 Domeng PAR 이탈)의 후속: 필리핀 PAR 이탈 후 일본 오키나와 방면 북상. 새로운 영향 지역(일본), 400+ 항공편 취소, JMA 긴급경보 — 진행 방향 변경으로 유의미한 신규 정보.
